title: Linear relations modulo meager sets
summary: We prove several topological zero-one laws. First, we show that, if a subset $A$ of a Banach space $X$ has the Baire property, then $A$ admits a somewhere dense set of vectors $x \in X$ such that $A+x$ agrees with $A$ modulo meager sets if and only if it is either meager or comeager. Additional equivalent conditions are given if $X=\mathbb{R}$.
